scope: Ten independent project implementations and shared build/security boundaries

verificationPolicy.ordinary: Per-module fresh, nonempty, consistent test-case reports; no failures/errors/skips
verificationPolicy.integration: Each selected integration module must execute actual dependency/process tests
verificationPolicy.mutation: KILLED only; surviving, uncovered and timed-out viable mutants stay in denominator; each selected module meets its declared threshold, at least 70%; runner/memory/unknown states fail
verificationPolicy.performance: Historical source-bound results preserved; no new quiet-host study or performance improvement inferred

shared.independentGateReview: Current POM conventions and per-module threshold/freshness behavior reviewed; namespace-based compiled dependency evasion closed

shared.securityInventory: Fresh complete177-package resolved SBOM scan passed with0HIGH/CRITICAL library findings;113external components have nonempty published licenses and SHA256; runtime-image findings remain separate/open
